facts.fact: 十七个月了还在恶化；他给对方一点控制权幻想换来点回应——一个不带厌恶的词或眼神——毫无效果。
facts.anchor: Seventeen months of this and it only gets worse. I guided him into this position myself… hands on his hips, telling him to take it, to move, to use me however he wants. Some delusional part of me keeps thinking that if I give him even a scrap of control he might finally crack and give me something back. A word or look that isn’t pure dislike, anything; but it’s not working.

facts.fact: 明天是 Kit 二十二岁生日；他知道日期全因去年那句生日自白——那天起胸口就压着一样赶不走的东西。
facts.anchor: Tomorrow is his twenty-second birthday. I only know because of last year… when he finally spoke more than two words to me and told me, voice wrecked, that no one had even realised it was his twenty-first; that no one had cared enough to ask. That was the day something uncomfortable settled in my chest and refused to leave.

facts.fact: 他继续对自己说这只是性；「不给我就谁也别想」的规矩必须立住。
facts.anchor: I still tell myself this is just sex. Just an obsession with the way he feels clenched around me, the sounds I can drag out of him, the way no one else has interested me in over a year. If he won’t give me his voice, then no one else gets it either. That rule still stands; it has to.
But right now, watching him struggle to take me in this position while I lose every scrap of control and fuck up into him like I’ll die if I stop, it’s getting harder to keep the lies straight.

facts.fact: Kit 破天荒喊出 Oh… I can’t… Soren!
十七个月来他的真名第一次从对方嘴里说出来。
facts.anchor: My name. For the first time in seventeen months, my actual name leaves his mouth

facts.fact: Kit 立刻捂嘴，像对自己泄了密而恼怒。
facts.anchor: He immediately slaps a hand over his lips like he’s furious with himself for letting it slip.

facts.fact: Lorraine：我这辈子没见过比这更严重的否认——等着吧，大变化快来了。
facts.anchor: I’ve never seen a worse case of denial in all my life. Just you wait, Soren Sinclair. I can feel a big change coming soon.”

facts.fact: Ray：你不能永远把他关着，他精神状态不好，所有人都看得见。
facts.anchor: you can’t keep him locked up forever. He’s not mentally well… everyone can see it.

facts.fact: Soren 只能嘟囔：他在里面很安全，没人能伤害他。
facts.anchor: He’s safe inside where no one can hurt him.

facts.fact: Lorraine 笑出声：你听听自己多酸——你对他有感情，我肯定。
facts.anchor: Do you realise how jealous you sound? You’ve got feelings for him. I just know it.

facts.fact: Ray 对 Kit 说生日快乐。
Soren 胸口发闷：这不是生日快乐，这空得不像话。
facts.anchor: This doesn’t feel like a happy birthday; it feels like something else entirely… something hollow.

facts.fact: Lorraine 低声斥责：这屋里每个人你都照顾周全，唯独冷落了你唯一真正放近身的人——全出于私心。
facts.anchor: Shame on you, Soren Sinclair. You know how to look after everyone else under this roof; your whole family. And yet you’ve neglected the one person you’ve ever actually let close to you… all for selfish reasons.

facts.fact: 他的冷面具滑落找不回来——或者说真正的问题是：他知道她说得对。
facts.anchor: my usual mask feels like it’s slipped and I can’t find it. I’m frozen in a moment that doesn’t feel like it belongs to me at all. Or maybe the real problem is that… I know she’s right.

facts.fact: Kit 面无表情应 Oh. Sure.
facts.anchor: Kit nods once, voice completely flat. “Oh. Sure.”

facts.fact: 他难堪地确认：对方去做蛋糕只因为是他指示的——不是想要、不是为了生日。
facts.anchor: The realisation settles uncomfortably: he’s only doing it because I told him to. Not because he wants to and not because it’s his birthday. Because I suggested it.

facts.fact: 他第一次被迫承认自己一直把对方当囚徒；不知道怎么停——既怕人找到他，也受不了看他跟除了自己以外的所有人交朋友。
facts.anchor: For the first time I’m forced to acknowledge that I’ve been treating him like a prisoner. The problem is… I don’t know how to stop. In my head the equation is still simple and brutal: if he leaves these walls, someone could find him; someone could hurt him. On top of that, I don’t know if I could stand watching him become friends with everyone in this house… everyone except me.
